videos.headline: Miller breaks Memphis' school record  for receptions
videos.description: Anthony Miller's 21-yard reception breaks the school record for career receptions with 213 for Memphis.

videos.headline: Ferguson to Miller gives Memphis the lead

videos.headline: Henderson off to the races for a TD
videos.description: Darrell Henderson scores a 52-yard touchdown on the first play after an extensive weather delay to give the Tigers a 21-point lead.

videos.headline: Hicks to Sutton strikes for TD for SMU
videos.description: Ben Hicks connects with Courtland Sutton for a 35-yard touchdown to give the Mustangs a 7-0 lead.

videos.headline: Wyatt's INT sets up SMU in Memphis territory
videos.description: Jordan Wyatt's 19-yard interception return ieads to a 27-yard field goal to extend the Mustangs lead to 10-0 in the first quarter.

videos.headline: Miller with a big gain for Memphis
videos.description: Anthony Miller's 48-yard gain on the bubble screen puts Memphis in the red zone for the first time in the game.

videos.headline: Jones rumbles for a big gain for SMU
videos.description: Xavier Jones 44-yard  run flips field position for the Mustangs.

videos.headline: Jones TD closes the gap for SMU
videos.description: Xavier Jones scores from 12 yards out to cut the deficit to 24-17 for SMU in the second quarter.

videos.headline: Hicks to Quinn makes it a one-score game for SMU
videos.description: Ben Hicks finds Trey Quinn for a 1-yard touchdown pass for SMU to cut the lead to 31-24 in the second quarter.

videos.headline: Epps TD catch closes the gap for SMU
videos.description: Raymond Epps first catch of the season results in a 17-yard touchdown to close the gap for the Mustangs.

videos.headline: Ferguson scores again for Memphis
videos.description: Riley Feruguson's second touchdown run pushes the lead to 45-31 for Memphis in the third quarter.

videos.headline: Jones gallops for big yards for SMU
videos.description: Xavier Jones runs for a 58-yard gain to put the Mustangs in the red zone in the third quarter.

videos.headline: Jones gets it done for SMU TD
videos.description: Xavier Jones second touchdown of the game makes it a one-score game for the Mustangs.

videos.headline: Ferguson to Miller strikes again for Memphis
videos.description: Anthony Miller's second touchdown catch of the game widens the lead for the Tigers.

videos.headline: Memphis breaks school record for single-game rushing TDs
videos.description: Riley Ferguson's 2-yard touchdown run breaks the school record for rushing touchdowns in one game with seven for Memphis.

videos.headline: Quinn's TD catch keeps SMU in the fight
videos.description: Trey Quinn's second touchdown catch of the game cuts the Memphis lead for SMU.
